scenario: [LSER.8.5.1]: a series takes one sample of its tracked slot per fact that enters working memory. An update to another slot is a new fact ([LFAC.2.5.3]) and adds a sample of the unchanged tracked value; a no-op reassertion adds none ([LFAC.2.5.1]). `S` is keyed on `k`, tracks `state` with `count sliding 1_h`, and carries an untracked `attr`. Rule `show` fires once per S fact that enters and logs the companion `s.count` and `s.attr`, as logical/LSER.8.6_series_frozen_within_a_pump reads it; its guard `s.count >= 0` is always true, so it has no false-to-true edge and a `where` re-evaluated across pumps ([LTIM.2.4.1]) adds no firing; a pump reads the series as it stood when it began and absorbs after the agenda drains ([LSER.8.6]). Step 1 asserts k1 state 20.0 attr "a": "0 a" (cold), then one sample. Step 2 asserts state 20.0 attr "b", an attribute-only change and so a new fact: "1 b", then a second sample. Step 3 asserts the same values again, a no-op: no fact enters, nothing fires, and no sample. Step 4 asserts attr "c", a new fact: "2 c". Exactly ["0 a", "1 b", "2 c"]. A runtime that sampled only when the tracked value changed logs "1 c"; one that sampled the no-op logs "3 c". Every firing is a fact's entry. PATH PINNED: the series absorb walk over a host assert, after no-op detection -- libds `engine_rete_adapters.c`'s absorb step, Mercury `ds.engine`'s.
rules_ds:
use default

schema S scope logical:
    k: Int key
    state: Float mutable
    attr: String mutable

series S.state (by: k):
    count sliding 1_h

rule show:
    S s where s.count >= 0
->
    log info "{s.count} {s.attr}"
